name: General
description: Any call: what was discussed, what was decided and what happens next.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.guidance: Why the call happened and how it ended, in two or three bullets.

sections.heading: Discussion
sections.guidance: The main topics in the order they came up, with the points made on each.

sections.heading: Decisions
sections.guidance: What was agreed on the call, and who agreed it when that was said.

sections.heading: Action items
sections.guidance: Tasks someone took on or was given on the call, as Owner: what, by when.

sections.heading: Open questions
sections.guidance: Questions raised and left unanswered, and who will follow up when that was said.
